description: This file defines a generic LoggerAdapter class implementing the IAppLogger interface, acting as an adapter for the Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger, to be used within the eShopOnWeb application's infrastructure layer for logging purposes.

classes.name: LoggerAdapter<T>
classes.description: A generic class that adapts the Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger to the application's IAppLogger interface, providing logging methods for warnings and information messages.

methods.name: LoggerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the internal logger using the provided ILoggerFactory.

methods.name: LogWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional parameters.

methods.name: LogInformation
methods.description: Logs an informational message with optional parameters.
